question_vi: Redux Toolkit createSlice hoạt động thế nào?
question_en: How does Redux Toolkit's createSlice work?
answer_html_vi:
createSlice kết hợp action creators + reducer trong cùng một file, dùng Immer nên có thể mutate state trực tiếp.

js
const userSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'user',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    setUser(state, action) { state.name = action.payload; }
  }
});
export const { setUser } = userSlice.actions;
export default userSlice.reducer;
answer_html_en:
createSlice combines the action creators and the reducer in one file, and uses Immer so you can write mutating-style updates directly.

js
const userSlice = createSlice({
  name: 'user',
  initialState,
  reducers: {
    setUser(state, action) { state.name = action.payload; }
  }
});
export const { setUser } = userSlice.actions;
export default userSlice.reducer;

It also generates the action type strings for you, so there is no separate constants file to maintain.
